lines.en: label rinfirstvisit:
I knock on Rin's door and wait for her to answer, not knowing quite sure how this is going to go since I've never actually hung out with her in her room before.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Rin 的门，等她来开，心里完全没底这会变成什么样——毕竟我从来没有真正在她房间里跟她待过。

lines.en: To be fair, though, out of all of the girls in the class, she definitely seems like one of the few who would let me in without question.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，在全班女生里，她绝对算是会二话不说就让我进去的那少数几个人之一。

lines.en: if rinfirsthall == True:
Hell, I'm pretty sure she would have let me in a little while back if she hadn't left her keys at school.
lines.zh: 见鬼，我很确定要不是她把钥匙忘在学校，她前阵子就已经让我进去了。

lines.en: But I guess all I can really do at this point is hope she comes to the door and doesn't think I'm here with any ulterior motives.
lines.zh: 不过事到如今我能做的，也只有希望她来开门，并且不觉得我是带着什么别的目的来的。

lines.en: Which I kind of am, of course. But I obviously don't want her to {i}think{/i} that.
lines.zh: 当然，我确实带着目的。但我显然不想让她{i}看出来{/i}。

lines.en: : Who goes there?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: : Your teacher.
lines.zh: : 你的老师。

lines.en: : My teacher? What?
lines.zh: : 我的老师？什么？

lines.en: : Hold on a second.
lines.zh: : 等一下啊。

lines.en: scene black
I hear some shuffling from inside of the room as Rin makes whatever preparations are necessary to come greet me.
lines.zh: 我听见房间里一阵窸窸窣窣，Rin 大概在做些必要的准备，好出来迎接我。

lines.en: The sound of some drawers closing is immediately succeeded by the light tapping of her shoes as she puts them on and decides to come greet me in the hall instead....
lines.zh: 抽屉合上的声音之后，紧接着是她穿鞋时轻轻的踢踏声——她决定还是到走廊上来迎接我……

lines.en: scene skullsredux1
: What's up? It's not like you to just show up at my door. You're more of a {i}show up everywhere else{/i} kind of guy.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你可不像会直接找上门的人。你更像那种{i}在别的地方到处偶遇人{/i}的类型。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I'm running out of other places to run into you, so I figured I'd come directly to your dorm this time.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我能偶遇你的地方快用完了，所以这次我想干脆直接来你宿舍。

lines.en: : Anything in particular bring you here? Or were you just in the mood to see my face for whatever reason?
lines.zh: : 有什么特别的事让你过来吗？还是你只是不知为什么想看看我的脸？

lines.en: : To be fair, it's a pretty nice face and I should be forgiven for seeking it out during my free time.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那张脸确实挺好看的，我在空闲时间想见一见，应该能被原谅吧。

lines.en: scene skullsredux2
: You sure you don't have anything more important to do?
lines.zh: : 你确定没有更重要的事要做？

lines.en: : More important than hanging out with my favorite barista?
lines.zh: : 比跟我最喜欢的咖啡师待在一起更重要？

lines.en: : Favorite out of...how many, exactly?
lines.zh: : 最喜欢……一共是有多少个来着？

lines.en: : Hey, for all you know, I could be a regular at tons of cafes.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说不定我可是很多家咖啡馆的常客呢。

lines.en: scene skullsredux3
: You wouldn't dare...
lines.zh: : 你不敢吧……

lines.en: : I could be convinced to drop all of them if a certain somebody lets me in her room, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是某个人肯让我进她的房间，我倒是可以被说服，把那些店全戒了。

lines.en: scene skullsredux4
: Sure. That didn't sound predatory at all.
lines.zh: : 当然。这话听起来一点都不像捕食者。

lines.en: : It sounded better in my head.
lines.zh: : 在我脑子里想的时候比说出来好听。

lines.en: scene skullsredux1
: Why my room, though? Wouldn't it make more sense for us to like, go somewhere else or something?
lines.zh: : 不过为什么是我的房间？我们不是该……去别的地方什么的，不是更合理吗？

lines.en: : I'm just...interested in seeing the same thing you see every morning?
lines.zh: : 我只是……想看看你每天早上看到的同一番景象？

lines.en: : Yikes. Your game needs some serious work, Sensei. You're much better at cafe banter than dorm room banter.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你的撩人功力得好好练练了，Sensei。你在咖啡馆的嘴皮子可比在宿舍里强多了。

lines.en: : I will do my best to improve for both of our sakes.
lines.zh: : 为了我们俩好，我会尽力改进的。

lines.en: scene skullsredux4
: I'll take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 那我就信你一回。

lines.en: : I'll also let you into my room if you promise not to only stop going to other cafes, but to stop saying weird and creepy shit.
lines.zh: : 我也可以让你进我的房间，只要你答应不只是不再去别的咖啡馆，还要不再说那些又怪又变态的话。

lines.en: : I don't know if you understand how hard that last part will be for me to accomplish.
lines.zh: : 你大概不知道最后那一条对我来说有多难做到。

lines.en: : Then I suppose we will have to find out together!
lines.zh: : 那我们只好一起看看结果了！

lines.en: : Now, onward to Casa del Rin!
lines.zh: : 那么，前进吧，Rin 之家！

lines.en: scene black
Rin guides me into the room and unstraps her boots after realizing that the two of us won't be going anywhere any time soon.
lines.zh: Rin 把我领进房间，意识到我们俩一时半会儿不会去哪儿之后，便解开了靴子。

lines.en: I direct my attention to what is easily apparent as her side of the room before she takes her place in front of me, unsure of how to proceed.
lines.zh: 她站到我面前、不知该如何继续之前，我把注意力投向了显然是她那一半的房间。

lines.en: scene skullsredux5
: So, I guess if you're going to mug me, now is the best possible time.
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你打算抢劫我的话，现在是最好的时机。

lines.en: : I'll abstain until the tour is over at the very least.
lines.zh: : 至少参观结束之前我不会动手。

lines.en: : Good call. It'll be a more effective shakedown if you know where all the good stuff is first.
lines.zh: : 明智。等你先摸清好东西都在哪儿，敲诈起来才更有效率。

lines.en: scene skullsredux6
: Well...if there {i}was{/i} any good stuff, I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说，如果{i}真有{/i}什么好东西的话。

lines.en: : Our room's way outdated compared to all of the other ones on this floor.
lines.zh: : 我们这间房比这层楼其他所有房间都过时得多。

lines.en: : We've been waiting for our upgrade for literally forever but Futaba kept offering to wait because her heart is too big for her body.
lines.zh: : 我们等翻修已经等了不知道多久，可 Futaba 一直说愿意再等等，因为她的心比她的身体还大。

lines.en: : What sort of {i}upgrade{/i} are you waiting for exactly?
lines.zh: : 你们具体在等什么样的{i}翻修{/i}？

lines.en: scene skullsredux7
: Pretty much everything. The school is kind enough to provide standard beds and stuff, but I think our floor and our color scheme is supposed to be changed or something too.
lines.zh: : 基本上是所有东西。学校很贴心地提供了标准床之类的，不过我记得地板和配色方案好像也要换什么的。

lines.en: : It's just annoying since I've got tons of stuff I want to hang up but {i}can't{/i} since I'll just have to take it all down once the thing starts.
lines.zh: : 烦人的是我有一大堆东西想挂起来，可一旦动工我就得全部取下来。

lines.en: : So...yeah. This is it for now. Sorry it's not really anything to write home about.
lines.zh: : 所以……是啊。眼下就是这样。抱歉，实在没什么值得炫耀的。

lines.en: : My side is on the right and Futaba’s is on the left.
lines.zh: : 右边是我的地盘，左边是 Futaba 的。

lines.en: : She’s obviously not here right now, so it looks like it's gonna be just you and me for the indefinite future.
lines.zh: : 她现在显然不在，所以看来接下来无限长的时间里，就只有你和我了。

lines.en: : And you don’t feel weird being alone in your room with an older man?
lines.zh: : 那你跟一个年长男人单独待在自己房间里，不觉得奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Well, I didn't until you said that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在你这么说之前我还没觉得。

lines.en: : I told you not sounding creepy wasn't going to work out.
lines.zh: : 我说过了吧，不显得变态这件事是做不到的。

lines.en: scene skullsredux8
: It's fine. We're still cool. I know you're not the type to try anything weird or whatever.
lines.zh: : 没事。我们还挺好的。我知道你不是那种会搞奇怪名堂的人。

lines.en: scene skullsredux9
: Besides, let's just say I have countermeasures in place in the event that you {i}do{/i} try anything.
lines.zh: : 再说了，就算你{i}真{/i}想搞什么，我这边也准备好了应对措施。

lines.en: : What...sort of countermeasures are you referring to, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你说的……到底是什么应对措施？

lines.en: : Nothing. Just don't look behind me.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是别看我身后。

lines.en: : Why? What's-
lines.zh: : 为什么？什么是——

lines.en: scene skullsredux10
I finally direct my attention to Rin's wall only to find a shelf comprised entirely of what appear to be...authentic human skulls.
lines.zh: 我终于把视线转向 Rin 那面墙，结果发现一整个架子上摆着的似乎全是……真正的人类头骨。

lines.en: : There's no way those are real, right?
lines.zh: : 那些不可能是真的吧？

lines.en: : What kind of weirdo would keep fake human skulls on a shelf? Come on, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 什么样的怪胎会在架子上摆假的人类头骨啊？拜托，Sensei。

lines.en: : What kind of psychopath would keep real ones?
lines.zh: : 那什么样的疯子会摆真的？

lines.en: : The kind who was nice enough to let you into her room! Is your way of showing thanks going to be insulting all of my things?
lines.zh: : 就是好心让你进她房间的那种疯子！你表达感谢的方式就是侮辱我所有的东西吗？

lines.en: : Are those even legal to own?
lines.zh: : 那些东西拥有起来合法吗？

lines.en: : Hey, I won't tell anyone if you don't. Leave my friends out of this.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不说我不说。别把我的朋友们扯进来。

lines.en: scene skullsredux9
: Okay. So I understand that there are real countermeasures in place now. Thank you for showing me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我现在明白了，确实是真有应对措施。谢谢你让我看。

lines.en: : Any time, Sensei. Always willing to share my hobbies with a friend.
lines.zh: : 随时奉陪，Sensei。我一向乐意和朋友分享我的爱好。

lines.en: : So...do you have any hobbies aside from collecting body parts?
lines.zh: : 那么……除了收集人体部件之外，你还有什么爱好吗？

lines.en: scene skullsredux11
: Nothing exciting. Just playing guitar and listening to music and stuff.
lines.zh: : 没什么刺激的。就是弹弹吉他、听听音乐什么的。

lines.en: : I guess that explains why you're always wearing headphones, then.
lines.zh: : 那我懂你为什么总戴着耳机了。

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t {i}always{/i} wear them. I’m headphone-less at work, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我又不是{i}总{/i}戴着。上班的时候就没戴，不是吗？

lines.en: : I think you're technically supposed to be headphone-less at school as well, but it's not like I plan on enforcing that any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我觉得严格来说你在学校也不该戴，不过我暂时不打算去管这事。

lines.en: : Good, cause I'm running out of room on my shelf.
lines.zh: : 那就好，因为我架子上的位置快不够了。

lines.en: : I'm going to ignore that casual threat of murder and ask you about your guitar.
lines.zh: : 我先忽略这句随口说出的杀人威胁，来问问你的吉他。

lines.en: : What would you like to know, good sir?
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，好先生？

lines.en: : How long have you been playing?
lines.zh: : 你弹了多久了？

lines.en: scene skullsredux12
: Not for super long, but long enough to be pretty decent at it.
lines.zh: : 不算特别久，但久到已经弹得相当不错了。

lines.en: : I've always loved music and stuff so my mom wound up buying me one for my birthday one year.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很喜欢音乐什么的，所以有一年我妈买了把吉他给我当生日礼物。

lines.en: : Needless to say, I've been kinda hooked ever since.
lines.zh: : 不用说，从那以后我就有点上瘾了。

lines.en: : Would you be able to play something for me?
lines.zh: : 你能弹点什么给我听吗？

lines.en: scene skullsredux13
: Like...Like now?
lines.zh: : 就……就现在？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : Uhh...probably because it's super embarrassing?
lines.zh: : 呃……大概因为这超级难为情？

lines.en: : You're not as good as you say you are, are you?
lines.zh: : 你没你自己说的那么厉害，是吧？

lines.en: : That's really not the problem here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 问题真不在这儿，Sensei。

lines.en: : What's the problem, then?
lines.zh: : 那问题在哪儿？

lines.en: : The problem is that if I sit down and play guitar for you, it'll be an important moment that winds up heavily influencing the direction our relationship goes.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，要是我坐下来给你弹吉他，那就会成为一个重要的瞬间，会大大影响我们关系走向的方向。

lines.en: : Haven't you ever played a dating sim before? Or watched literally any sort of indie romance film?
lines.zh: : 你没玩过恋爱模拟游戏吗？或者哪怕看过任何一部独立爱情片？

lines.en: : I have not done either of those things, no.
lines.zh: : 这两样我都没做过，没有。

lines.en: : Jesus. Next, you're going to tell me you don't listen to music either.
lines.zh: : 天哪。接下来你是不是要说你也不听音乐？

lines.en: scene skullsredux14
: Holy fuck!
lines.zh: : 我操！

lines.en: : Is there some sort of crime against...not listening to music?
lines.zh: : 不听音乐算是什么罪吗？

lines.en: : Not a real one, but a social crime- yeah!
lines.zh: : 不算真正的罪，但算是社交上的罪——对！

lines.en: : Only creepy, borderline-sociopathic serial killers don't listen to music! That's like, an inarguable fact!
lines.zh: : 只有阴森、近乎反社会的连环杀手才不听音乐！这可是……不争的事实！

lines.en: : Why would you even want to hear me play guitar if you don't like music? Wouldn't it bore you? Would you just walk away halfway through?
lines.zh: : 你既然不喜欢音乐，又为什么想听我弹吉他？不会觉得无聊吗？会不会听到一半就走人？

lines.en: : I have so many questions!
lines.zh: : 我有好多问题！

lines.en: : Well, I apologize for not being a standard human, but you can take solace in the fact that I am probably not going to kill you.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我很抱歉不是个标准人类，不过你大可放心，我大概不会杀你。

lines.en: scene skullsredux15
: You know I'm gonna have to show you some stuff now, right? I can't just let you live a life without music in it. That's no life at all.
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在非得给你看点东西了吧？我不能让你在没有音乐的人生里活下去。那根本算不上人生。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. It's not like I hate music or anything. It just...never stuck with me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 你随便。我又不是讨厌音乐什么的。只是……它一直没能留住我，大概吧。

lines.en: : Wack. You're a weird dude, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 怪人。你真是个怪人，Sensei。

lines.en: : You have a shelf full of human skulls.
lines.zh: : 你有一整架子的人类头骨。

lines.en: scene skullsredux16
: No. I have a shelf full of {i}friends.{/i} It's very different.
lines.zh: : 不。我有一整架子的{i}朋友。{/i}这很不一样。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, on that note, I should probably get going. Ami normally complains if I’m late.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那么，话说回来，我大概该走了。我要是晚回去，Ami 通常会抱怨。

lines.en: scene skullsredux7
: Oh, right! I totally forgot you two were even related.
lines.zh: : 哦，对！我完全忘了你们俩居然是亲戚。

lines.en: : Tell her I said hi, okay?
lines.zh: : 替我向她问好，好吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I-
lines.zh: : 好的。我——

lines.en: : Wait. Actually, {i}don’t{/i} tell her I said hi. Because I know Ami and she’d probably be like 'Where did you see Rin?' And then you’d be all like 'In her room.'
lines.zh: : 等等。其实，{i}别{/i}替我问好了。因为我了解 Ami，她大概会说“你在哪儿见到 Rin 的？”然后你就会说“在她房间里。”

lines.en: : And then she'd be all like 'In her ROOM?' and then you would be all like 'Yeah. She's got skulls.'
lines.zh: : 然后她会说“在她房间里？”然后你就会说“对。她有骷髅。”

lines.en: : And then it would just be weird for everybody and no one would win.
lines.zh: : 然后大家都会觉得尴尬，谁也没好处。

lines.en: : So, yeah. Don't say hi.
lines.zh: : 所以，对。别问好了。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene skullsredux9
: Neat. Well, I guess that about wraps things up then.
lines.zh: : 不错。那么，我想今天就到这儿吧。

lines.en: : Thanks for dropping by, Sensei. Make sure to bring an offering the next time you show up.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你过来，Sensei。下次来记得带点供品。

lines.en: : I'll come by again, but...I don't know if I can guarantee the offering part.
lines.zh: : 我会再来的，不过……供品那部分我不敢保证。

lines.en: : Yeah, we'll see about that.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，那就走着瞧吧。

lines.en: : Right...Goodnight, Rin.
lines.zh: : 好……晚安，Rin。

lines.en: : Night, Sensei! See ya round!
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei！回头见！

lines.en: scene black
$ rin_love += 1
$ rinfirstvisit = True
I exit Rin's room and...
lines.zh: 我走出 Rin 的房间，然后……

lines.en: Honestly, I think I know even less about her now than I did {i}before{/i} I entered.
lines.zh: 说实话，我觉得现在的我比进去{i}之前{/i}更不了解她了。

lines.en: {i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can now spend time with her in her room!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在你可以去她房间里陪她了！{/i}
